spans.s:
f. (-की)
One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes.

m. (-नः)
Air, wind.
n. (-नं)
Rubbing, grinding, pressing.
E.
मुट to rub, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.

n. (-तं)
One of the ten Bhāvas, or properties of women, the silent expression of returned affection.
